issues.summary: Blueprint AC section declares only 16 ACs (FR-3/4/5/6/8 + CC) but Plan, Tests, and PVs reference 35 ACs (adding FR-1/2/7 + 9 NFR ACs) without those being declared in the Blueprint.

evidence.detail: Section enumerates AC-FR-3-a/b/c, AC-FR-4-a/b, AC-FR-5-a/b, AC-FR-6-a/b/c/d, AC-FR-8-a, AC-CC-1/2/3/4 only. No AC-FR-1-*, AC-FR-2-*, AC-FR-4-c, AC-FR-7-*, AC-NFR-*-* declared.

Maps tasks to 35 ACs including AC-FR-1-a/b/c (satisfied-upstream), AC-FR-2-a/b/c (vacuous-by-kc2), AC-FR-4-c, AC-FR-7-a, AC-NFR-1-a/b, AC-NFR-2-a/b, AC-NFR-3-a/b, AC-NFR-4-a, AC-NFR-5-a, AC-NFR-6-a/b, AC-NFR-7-a.
Lists same 35 ACs with verifying tests.

evidence.section: PV-* 'Acceptance tests scheduled for this phase' rows
evidence.detail: References 28 of those same downstream ACs.

issues.impact: Downstream artifacts presume PRD-inherited ACs (AC-FR-1-*, AC-FR-2-*, AC-FR-7-*, AC-NFR-*) propagate to the Blueprint, but the Blueprint AC section never reproduces or explicitly inherits them. A reader cross-checking the Blueprint cannot verify that downstream tests/validators match Blueprint commitments; tooling that audits AC coverage by parsing the Blueprint AC section will report orphans for 19 ACs.
issues.recommended_resolution: Either (a) add an 'Inherited from PRD' subsection to the Blueprint AC section enumerating AC-FR-1/2/7 and all AC-NFR-* with their EARS text (preserving the Blueprint as the single AC source-of-truth per shared convention), OR (b) add a frontmatter / prose declaration that the Blueprint AC section is the delta-only view and PRD ACs propagate transitively, with an explicit list of inherited IDs.

issues.summary: acceptance-tests.md self-reports '51 tests covering all 30 ACs' (Update History + Total tests line 121) but actually contains 54 tests covering 35 ACs. Plan Update History row also asserts 'All 30 ACs mapped' while its own table maps 35.

evidence.detail: Inventory table contains 54 rows (`grep -cE '^\| T-AC-' = 54`); per-test detail blocks `grep -cE '^### T-AC-' = 54`; coverage matrix references 35 distinct ACs.
States '**Total tests:** 51.'
Claims 33 L1 + 11 L2 + 7 L3 = 51 tests; actual L-column distribution in inventory is 27 L1 + 14 L2 + 13 L3 = 54 tests.
'51 tests covering all 30 ACs'.
'All 30 ACs mapped' yet the Acceptance Test Cross-Reference table contains 35 mapping rows.

issues.impact: Documents present internally inconsistent self-reported counts. A consumer cross-checking 'tests cover all ACs' from headline metrics gets one number; from line-level inventory gets another. The orchestrator prompt for this audit propagated the 51 / 33 / 11 / 7 number, demonstrating downstream contamination.
issues.recommended_resolution: Update three locations in acceptance-tests.md: (a) line 121 '**Total tests:** 51' → 54; (b) Verification-layer summary table → 27 / 14 / 13; (c) Update History note → '54 tests covering 35 ACs'. Update plan-v1.md Update History row → 'All 35 ACs mapped' (or 30 PRD + 4 CC + 1 FR-4-c = 35 — pick a true denominator).

issues.summary: AC-NFR-4-a (Discovery investigation finding artifact preservation) has zero Phase Validator coverage: Plan maps it to 'satisfied-upstream' with no in-phase task; Tests provides T-AC-NFR-4-a-finding-artifact; but no PV-* schedules it. Result: an AC verified by a test that no validator gates.

evidence.section: Acceptance Test Cross-Reference row for AC-NFR-4-a (line 572)
evidence.detail: 'already satisfied upstream by T-001 research note ... no new task required in this Plan.'
L1 file-existence + grep test exists.

evidence.section: PV-0 through PV-6 'Acceptance tests scheduled for this phase' rows
evidence.detail: grep -c 'AC-NFR-4-a' returns 0 across all PV entries; no validator explicitly schedules the satisfied-upstream check.

issues.impact: If the T-001 research note is missing, moved, or its `dispatch_supported: false` flag changes, no phase gate detects this. The test exists but never runs as part of any phase's pass criteria.
issues.recommended_resolution: Add a PV-0 criterion (PV-0.C5) asserting the satisfied-upstream FR-1/NFR-4 artifacts exist with the load-bearing flags — or extend PV-0.C1 to include the T-001 research-note presence check. Mirror the same pattern for AC-FR-1-a/b/c which are also satisfied-upstream but have no PV gate.

issues.artifact_pair: Plan frontmatter ↔ Plan Update History body
issues.summary: Plan v1.1.0 frontmatter `version_history` lists both v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 entries, but the Plan's body 'Update History' table contains only the v1.0.0 row. The v1.1.0 patch (per frontmatter: 'absorbing reviewer findings I-Plan-001/002/004') is not reflected in the human-readable Update History.

evidence.detail: version_history lists both v1.0.0 and v1.1.0 with their notes.
Table contains a single row for v1.0.0; no v1.1.0 row.

issues.impact: Reader checking Update History for change provenance cannot see the v1.1.0 patch was issued; only the frontmatter records it. Discrepancy violates the convention that body Update History mirrors frontmatter version_history.
issues.recommended_resolution: Add a v1.1.0 row to the body Update History table mirroring the frontmatter version_history note.

issues.summary: PV documents anticipate acceptance-test IDs of the form `AT-FR-X-y-PN` (e.g., AT-FR-4-b-P1, AT-CC-2-P2) but the actual acceptance-tests.md uses `T-AC-FR-X-y-<descriptor>` IDs (e.g., T-AC-FR-4-b-schema-lockstep). The PV doc explicitly disclaims this gap ('expected nomenclature') but it remains a cross-artifact ID mismatch that hampers automated traceability.

evidence.detail: e.g., PV-1: 'AT-FR-4-b-P1, AT-NFR-5-a-P1, AT-CC-2-P1 (expected nomenclature)'.
All test IDs use `T-AC-<AC-ID>-<descriptor>` form; no `AT-…-PN` IDs exist.
Acknowledges parallel authoring and ID nomenclature divergence; surfaces as an open issue.

issues.impact: Auto-traceability tooling that joins PV scheduling rows to Acceptance Tests by ID will fail to match. The PV authoring acknowledged the gap up front, but the gap is real.
issues.recommended_resolution: Either (a) PV doc updates 'Acceptance-test IDs (parallel doc)' rows to reference actual T-AC-* IDs that exist in acceptance-tests.md, OR (b) tests doc adds an alias mapping table cross-referencing T-AC-* → expected AT-…-PN names.

issues.artifact_pair: Tests coverage matrix ↔ Plan AC mapping
issues.summary: Tests doc 'Coverage status' (line 995) claims 'no orphan tests', but the AC coverage matrix shows AC-FR-4-c (referenced by Plan T3.4/T3.5 satisfaction list) has only L2 git-diff test T-AC-FR-4-c-leaf-specialists-substantive whose AC is referenced by Plan + PV but does not exist in Blueprint AC section (see I-CA-001). Marginal duplicate-coverage rows for AC-NFR-2-a/3-a explicitly shared with FR-6-a/6-b are NOT separately surfaced as 'overlapping with' in the inventory column.

evidence.detail: Test exists for AC-FR-4-c.
Blueprint enumerates AC-FR-4-a, AC-FR-4-b only — no AC-FR-4-c declaration.
Maps T3.4, T3.5 to AC-FR-4-c.

issues.impact: If AC-FR-4-c truly doesn't exist in the Blueprint (rather than being inherited from PRD), the Plan/Tests/PV row referencing it points to an undeclared AC. This is a sub-finding of I-CA-001 and resolves with the same remediation.
issues.recommended_resolution: Resolve via I-CA-001 fix. If AC-FR-4-c is intended to be Blueprint-declared, add its EARS row to Blueprint AC section under FR-4.

issues.summary: Tests doc reports '14 operator-facing tests' in Update History row, with table at line 1019-1036 enumerating 14 such tests. PV doc 'Validator coverage summary' line 837 reports only PV-6.C3 is operator-facing among the 42 criteria (i.e., 1 operator-mediated gate). Both are technically correct under their own scoping (per-test vs per-validator-criterion), but the two views are not cross-referenced.

evidence.detail: 14 tests enumerated as operator-facing, all gated on Phase 6 synthetic run.
'1 criterion is operator-facing (PV-6.C3); 2 criteria are mixed automation (PV-4.C4, PV-6.C5)'.

issues.impact: Reader trying to determine total operator workload may double-count or under-count depending on which document they read first.
issues.recommended_resolution: PV-6 description could add a footnote: 'PV-6 aggregates 14 operator-facing acceptance tests under PV-6.C3-C9; operator action is required once (the session restart + synthetic test run), and validator criteria parse the resulting artifacts.'

issues.summary: Plan T5.2 marks AC-FR-8-a as 'interim discipline portion' but the AC text in Blueprint says 'design-composer determines a project-wide convention is warranted, the system shall produce an ADR documenting the convention'. The Blueprint AC is satisfied by ADR-0045 existing at canonical root (PV-0.C1 already verifies). PV-5.C4 then ALSO claims to verify AC-FR-8-a 'interim discipline portion'. The AC is single-trigger ('produce an ADR') but split across two validators with no clear primary/secondary marking.

evidence.detail: Single 'Resolved' clause naming ADR-0045 at adrs/.
T0.1 verifies ADR placement; T5.2 documents interim discipline (AC-FR-8-a (interim discipline portion)).
PV-0.C1 covers ADR placement; PV-5.C4 covers interim discipline.

issues.impact: Reader cannot tell which PV is the canonical gate for AC-FR-8-a. Multiple coverage is acceptable but should be marked primary/secondary.
issues.recommended_resolution: In PV-5.C4, add 'satisfies AC-FR-8-a (manual-review interim portion); ADR-existence portion satisfied by PV-0.C1.' Mirror in PV-0.C1.

verdict_rationale: Four important consistency issues across the artifact set, no critical issues. The most consequential (I-CA-001: 19 ACs referenced downstream but undeclared in Blueprint AC section) and the related count-discrepancy issue (I-CA-002: 51-vs-54 tests, 30-vs-35 ACs) are mechanical fixes that don't require redesign — they require Blueprint AC-section expansion and document-level count corrections. The audit verifies the four artifacts tell substantially the same story on the load-bearing dimensions (ADR-0017+0033 citations, bundled-commit invariant, F-7 fresh-session gate, ADR-0034→0033 3-occurrence sweep, ADR-0036 canonical-root placement, edit ordering D-004→D-001). The auditor recommends one revision cycle via finalize-reconciler to absorb the AC enumeration and count corrections; subsequent rounds should converge quickly given the issues are textual/mechanical rather than architectural.
convergence_note: Round 1: no prior_audit_path; convergence verdict 'first_round' applies. Hard cap at round 4 per ADR-0017.
